analysis_rules.common_random_numbers: All arms within a starting structure use identical seed identities. Contrasts are paired by seed.
analysis_rules.equal_channel_dose_rule: Every active channel receives the same normalized dose as its corresponding single-channel arm. Pair and triple arms therefore use more total effort.
analysis_rules.equal_total_effort_breadth_premium: Q_multichannel - max(Q_single among included channels), using matched structure, seed, intensity, and SUPPORT_OFF horizon.
analysis_rules.equal_total_effort_rule: For k active channels, each receives intensity/k normalized developmental dose so total normalized effort equals the single-channel reference.
analysis_rules.multiple_testing: Report all preregistered structure-by-intensity contrasts with bootstrap 95 percent intervals. Emphasize sign consistency and effect magnitude; do not select only favorable cells.
analysis_rules.retention_interpretation: SUPPORT_OFF at +360 days measures capability and indigenous coverage retained after the common 120-day developmental prehistory ends.
analysis_rules.triple_factorial_interaction: Q_ABC - Q_AB - Q_AC - Q_BC + Q_A + Q_B + Q_C - Q_control

description: Tests whether simultaneous indigenous development across complementary military services can lift whole-system autonomy, whether gains are superadditive at equal per-channel dose, and whether broader development improves allocation efficiency when total normalized effort is fixed.
design_disclosure: Designed after Stage-4 results were known. Stage-4 motivated the questions about headroom, complementarity, and coordinated development. All Stage-5 cells, hypotheses, estimands, and analysis rules are frozen before any Stage-5 production outcome is observed.

hypotheses.H_D1: At equal per-channel dose, multi-channel indigenous development produces positive complementarity interactions in terminal retained whole-system autonomy when multiple services are jointly constraining.
hypotheses.H_D2: At fixed total normalized development effort, allocating development across multiple near-binding services can outperform concentrating the same effort in one service when initial constraint headroom is small.
hypotheses.H_D3: The benefit of broader development is larger in near-tie systems than in systems with one dominant bottleneck and large headroom to the next constraint.
hypotheses.H_D4: Broader indigenous development reduces or delays bottleneck migration and increases the fraction of capability retained after development stops.

name: Stage 5: Coordinated Indigenous Development
